profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack developer with extensive experience in fast-paced, result-driven environments.  Able to effectively self-manage during independent projects and collaborate as part of a team.   Proven track record of success in remote work environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack developer for digital cancer care navigation platform.  Front-end development using ReactJS, Next.js, and Flutter/Dart.  Back-end development using Django/Python, GraphQL, PostgreSQL.  Worked with multiple Google Cloud Platform services, including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, FHIR Stores, and Secret Manager.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Pub/Sub · GraphQL · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · Google BigQuery · Apollo GraphQL · Python · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Full stack developer for a web-based assessment and badging platform and other education technology projects.  Front-end development using React.js, React Redux, React Router, and Webpack.  Back-end development using Django/Python, Django REST Framework, and PostgreSQL.  Worked with multiple AWS platforms and APIs, including EC2, RDS, S3, Route 53, and CloudFormation.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · JavaScript

positions.title: Web Applications Developer
positions.description: Member of the professional development staff providing technical expertise and assistance for projects focused on technology solutions for journalism.  Front-end and back-end web development using Flask, Django, and JavaScript.  Wrote scripts for application deployments to AWS using Fabric.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · JavaScript

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description: Front-end development of internal tools using JavaScript, HTML, CSS.

positions.title: Mobile Development Director
positions.description: Lead client-side developer for Palm OS handheld and offline web applications.  Server-side development using Django, Python, PHP, MySQL.  Designed and implemented procedures for data synchronization over desktop and wireless connections using XML-RPC and AJAX/JSON.

positions.title: Software Developer and Non-Managing Partner
positions.description: Development of web-based and command-line image conversion and compression tools.  Developed and maintained the online store, affiliate network, and internal admin systems.  Provided product documentation, customer service, and technical support.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Co-developer and lead programmer for a GIF animation editor/optimizer.  Assisted in the user interface design and implementation of Photoshop filter plug-ins.  Developed and maintained internal, web-based tools using HTML, MySQL, Perl, CGI, JavaScript.  Provided product documentation, customer service, and technical support.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Economics/Mathematical Methods in the Social Sciences (MMSS)

projects.title: NewsRecs
projects.description:
Personalized news recommendations for Twitter users, based on a student project.
Front-end development using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Embedly.
Back-end development using Python, Flask, Elasticsearch.

projects.title: Infolab Architecture for Contextual Knowledge
projects.description: Another work in progress. A suite of Python based tools for managing contextual knowledge related to web content. This includes resources for article text and metadata extraction from web pages, keyword and named entity extraction, and more.
